newsitem.title: UK: Scotia shares gain after research review.
newsitem.headline: Scotia shares gain after research review.

text.p: Shares in biotechnology group Scotia Holdings Plc rose on Thursday after a research review from the company highlighted progress on two key projects.
The stock was up 18-1/2p at 556-1/2 by 1043 GMT, rebounding since touching an eight-month low of 525p on October 10.

Scotia said its Foscan laser treatment for treating cancer was on track to start Phase III U.S. clinical trials, following a meeting between the company and the U.S. Food and Drug Administration on September 27.
The company also said the European Medicines Evaluation Agency had accepted for evaluation a drug called EF27, for the prevention of radiotherapy side effects.
It said this was positive because the Agency "only assesses products for novel indications of significant therapeutic interest."
Scotia said other priority projects were continuing to make satisfactory progress.
